text: combination `model_name` `source` determines model loaded. guide common options: Sources Example Models: `source = "torchvision"`: Accesses models PyTorch's `torchvision.models`. Common `model_name` examples: `"alexnet"`, `"vgg16"`, `"resnet18"`, `"resnet50"`, `"vit_b_16"` Pretrained weights typically ImageNet-1k. `model_parameters`: Can sometimes used specify specific weights, e.g., `list(weights = 'IMAGENET1K_V2')` ResNet50, though `"DEFAULT"` often sufficient. See torchvision docs available weights per model. `source = "timm"`: Accesses models `pytorch-image-models` library (extensive collection). Common `model_name` examples: `"efficientnet_b0"`, `"convnext_tiny"`, `"vit_base_patch16_224"`, `"resnet50"` Find available models via `timm` documentation `timm.list_models()` Python. `model_parameters`: Usually needed basic extraction. `source = "keras"`: Accesses models `tensorflow.keras.applications`. Common `model_name` examples: `"VGG16"`, `"ResNet50"`, `"InceptionV3"`, `"EfficientNetB0"` (Note: often capitalized). Pretrained weights typically ImageNet-1k. `model_parameters`: Usually needed. `source = "ssl"`: Accesses Self-Supervised Learning models. ResNet50 variants: `"simclr-rn50"`, `"mocov2-rn50"`, `"barlowtwins-rn50"`, `"vicreg-rn50"`, `"swav-rn50"`, etc. DINO Vision Transformers: `"dino-vit-small-p8"`, `"dino-vit-base-p16"`, etc. DINOv2 Vision Transformers: `"dinov2-vit-small-p14"`, `"dinov2-vit-base-p14"`, etc. MAE Vision Transformers: `"mae-vit-base-p16"`, `"mae-vit-large-p16"`, etc. `model_parameters`: **Important ViT models (DINO, MAE)!** Use `list(token_extraction = ...)` specify handle output tokens. Options : `"cls_token"`: Use [CLS] token output. `"avg_pool"`: Average pool patch tokens (excluding [CLS]). `"cls_token+avg_pool"`: Concatenate [CLS] token averaged patch tokens. `source = "custom"`: Accesses models specifically packaged handled `thingsvision`. Official CLIP: `model_name = "clip"`. Requires `model_parameters = list(variant = "ViT-B/32")` `"RN50"`, etc. Needs `pip install git+https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git` Python env. OpenCLIP: `model_name = "OpenCLIP"`. Requires `model_parameters = list(variant = "ViT-B-32", dataset = "laion2b_s34b_b79k")`, etc. Check OpenCLIP repo available variant/dataset pairs. CORnet: `model_name = "cornet_s"`, `"cornet_r"`, `"cornet_rt"`, `"cornet_z"`. Recurrent vision models. Ecoset Trained Models: `model_name = "Alexnet_ecoset"`, `"VGG16_ecoset"`, `"Resnet50_ecoset"`, `"Inception_ecoset"`. Trained Ecoset dataset. Harmonization Models: `model_name = "Harmonization"`. Requires `model_parameters = list(variant = "ViT_B16")` `"ResNet50"`, etc. Needs extra installation steps (see thingsvision README). DreamSim Models: `model_name = "DreamSim"`. Requires `model_parameters = list(variant = "open_clip_vitb32")` `"clip_vitb32"`, etc. Needs `pip install dreamsim==0.1.2` Python env. Segment Anything (SAM): `model_name = "SegmentAnything"`. Requires `model_parameters = list(variant = "vit_h")` `"vit_l"`, `"vit_b"`. Kakaobrain ALIGN: `model_name = "Kakaobrain_Align"`. `model_parameters` Argument: R `list` converted Python dictionary passed underlying `thingsvision` model loading function. essential models just `model_name` enough, like specifying variants (`"ViT-B/32"` CLIP), training datasets (`"laion2b_s34b_b79k"` OpenCLIP), special extraction methods (`token_extraction` DINO/MAE ViTs). Return Value: function returns `reticulate` Python object. object wrapper around Python `thingsvision` extractor instance. pass object functions like `tv_extract()` `show_model()`. Finding Models: --date comprehensive list models available `torchvision`, `timm`, `keras`, `ssl`, please refer respective documentations. `custom` models, refer `thingsvision` documentation: https://vicco-group.github.io/thingsvision/AvailableModels.html
